description: A road surface reconstruction dataset for autonomous driving is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Tong Zhao et al. Recent developments in intelligent robot systems, especially autonomous vehicles, put forward higher requirements for safety and comfort. Road conditions affect the overall performance of ground vehicles. Nonetheless, existing environment perception datasets for autonomous driving lack attention to road surface areas. Coverage: not stated; published in 2024. Formats: Image, Point cloud, ZIP. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 16235161588 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
